messages.subject: Error with ReturnType
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm new to Nimble, particularly nimbleFunction and I have a problem with ReturnType when I compile my function. I'm sorry if this subject has already been discussed, but I didn't see anything that I can understand.

I created this function that takes the mu and sigma of a normal distribution, then creates nb_class intervals and calculates the probability of these intervals. The end result is a vector of length (nb_class + 2), because I specified min and max bounds.

# Créer la fonction Nimble
f.prop.taille <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(mu = double(0), sigma = double(0), nb_class = double(0)) {
    # Définition des bornes min/max
    borne_min <- 0
    borne_max <- 100
   
    # Calculer les points de rupture en fonction de la plage de valeurs
    breaks_names <- seq(mu - 4*sigma, mu + 4*sigma, length.out = nb_class + 1)
   
    # Calculer les probabilités cumulatives pour chaque intervalle
    prob_intervals <- pnorm(c(borne_min, breaks_names, borne_max), mean = mu, sd = sigma)
   
    # Calculer la différence entre les probabilités cumulatives consécutives
    prop <- prob_intervals[-1] - prob_intervals[-length(prob_intervals)]
   
    returnType(double(1))
    return(prop)
  }
)

And I get this error when i compiled my function I have :
Cf.prop.taille <- compileNimble(f.prop.taille)
Compiling [Note] This may take a minute. [Note] Use 'showCompilerOutput = TRUE' to see C++ compilation details. Erreur : Number of dimensions 0 of the return() argument does not match number 1 given in the returnType() statement. This occurred for: return(prop) This was part of the call: { borne_min <- 0 borne_max <- 100 breaks_names <- nimSeqLenD(ARG1_mu_ - 4 * ARG2_sigma_,ARG1_mu_ + 4 * ARG2_sigma_,0,ARG3_nb_class_ + 1) prob_intervals <- pnorm(q=nimCd(concatenateTemp(ConcatenateInterm_32),breaks_names,concatenateTemp(ConcatenateInterm_34)),mean=ARG1_mu_,sd=ARG2_sigma_,lower.tail=TRUE,log.p=FALSE) prop <- (prob_intervals[-(1)] - prob_intervals[-(size(prob_intervals))]) return(prop) } 

I don't get where I'm wrong.

Thanks in advance for helping me !
Eliot

messages.author: f116cbe5c604c988
messages.subject: Re: Error with ReturnType
parts:
Eliot, unfortunately, the use of negative numbers to index a vector won't work in nimbleFunctions.  That isn't supported in the same way as in R.

So you'll need to change that one line to something more like:

n <- length(prob_intervals)
prop <- prob_intervals[2:n] - prob_intervals[1:(n-1)]

Cheers,
Daniel
